publishButton.description: Title bar button that publishes the fiddle as a GitHub gist, or opens the gist menu once a gist is loaded.

menuLabel.description: Accessible name of the gist menu opened from the Publish button.

menuUpdate.description: Gist menu item that uploads the current files to the loaded gist.

menuPublishNew.description: Gist menu item that publishes the fiddle as a separate, new gist.

menuCopyLink.description: Gist menu item that copies a link to the loaded gist.

menuHistory.description: Gist menu item that opens the gist's revision history.

openGist.description: Title bar button (its accessible name and tooltip) and gist menu item that open the dialog to load a gist by URL or ID. Same wording as the File menu's Open gist command.

menuVisibility.description: Header above the Secret and Public choices in the gist menu. Applies to the next published gist.

menuDelete.description: Gist menu item that deletes the loaded gist from GitHub.

visibilitySecret.description: Gist visibility: only people with the link can see it.

visibilityPublic.description: Gist visibility: anyone can find it on GitHub.

cancel.description: Button that closes a gist dialog without doing anything.

close.description: Accessible name of the close button on gist dialogs and toasts.

signInTitle.description: Title of the GitHub sign-in dialog.

signInDescription.message: Publishing gists needs a personal access token with the gist scope.
signInDescription.description: Explanation under the sign-in dialog title.

signInTokenLabel.description: Label of the token field in the sign-in dialog.

signInCreateToken.description: Button that opens GitHub's new-token page with the gist scope already selected.

signInClipboardHint.message: There's a token on your clipboard. Leave this empty to sign in with it.
signInClipboardHint.description: Help text under the empty token field when the clipboard holds a token. The token itself is never shown.

signInRemember.message: Remember the token on this computer
signInRemember.description: Checkbox shown on Linux without a keyring. Checking it stores the token as plain text.

signInRememberHelp.message: This system has no keyring, so the token would be stored as plain text. Leave this off to sign in until you quit.
signInRememberHelp.description: Help text under the remember checkbox in the sign-in dialog.

signInSessionOnly.message: This system can't store the token securely, so you'll stay signed in until you quit.
signInSessionOnly.description: Note in the sign-in dialog when the OS offers no encryption.

signInSubmit.description: Button that checks the token and signs in to GitHub.

signInErrorFormat.message: That doesn't look like a GitHub token. Tokens start with ghp_ or github_pat_.
signInErrorFormat.description: Sign-in error when the token has the wrong format. ghp_ and github_pat_ are literal prefixes; keep them.

signInErrorInvalid.message: GitHub didn't accept this token. Check that it's current and copied in full.
signInErrorInvalid.description: Sign-in error when GitHub rejects the token (401 or 403).

signInErrorScope.message: This token doesn't have the gist scope. Create one with gist selected.
signInErrorScope.description: Sign-in error when the token lacks the gist scope. 'gist' is GitHub's scope name; keep it.

signInErrorNetwork.message: Couldn't reach GitHub. Check your internet connection and try again.
signInErrorNetwork.description: Sign-in error when the computer is offline or GitHub is unavailable.

signInErrorOther.description: Sign-in error for any other failure. {{message}} is the error reported by GitHub.

signedIn.description: Toast after a successful sign-in. {{login}} is the GitHub user name.

signedInSession.message: You'll stay signed in until you quit.
signedInSession.description: Toast detail when the token couldn't be stored and lasts only for this session.

publishTitle.description: Title of the dialog that publishes the fiddle as a new gist.

publishDescriptionLabel.description: Label of the gist description field in the publish dialog.

publishDefaultDescription.description: Default description of a new gist. Electron Fiddle is the product name.

publishDescriptionError.description: Validation message when the gist description is empty or too long.

publishVisibilityLabel.description: Label of the Secret or Public choice in the publish dialog.

publishVisibilityHelp.message: Secret gists are hidden from search, but anyone with the link can see them.
publishVisibilityHelp.description: Help text under the visibility choice in the publish dialog.

published.description: Toast after a gist is published.

updated.description: Toast after the loaded gist is updated.

deleted.description: Toast after the loaded gist is deleted.

copyLink.description: Toast action that copies the gist link.

linkCopied.description: Toast after the gist link is copied to the clipboard.

publishFailed.description: Error toast title when publishing fails.

updateFailed.description: Error toast title when updating fails.

deleteFailed.description: Error toast title when deleting fails.

errorWithHint.description: Error toast body: the error GitHub reported, then a hint. Keep both placeholders.

hintConnectivity.message: Check your internet connection and try again.
hintConnectivity.description: Hint after a gist error caused by being offline or GitHub being unavailable.

hintOwnership.message: Check that you're signed in as the gist's owner.
hintOwnership.description: Hint after a gist update or delete fails because the gist belongs to someone else.

deleteConfirmTitle.description: Title of the confirmation before deleting the loaded gist.

deleteConfirmMessage.message: The gist and its history are removed from GitHub. Your files stay open here.
deleteConfirmMessage.description: Body of the confirmation before deleting the loaded gist.

deleteConfirm.description: Button that confirms deleting the gist.

historyTitle.description: Title of the dialog listing the gist's revisions.

historyDescription.message: Choose a revision to load it.
historyDescription.description: Explanation under the history dialog title.

historyListLabel.description: Accessible name of the list of gist revisions.

historyCreated.description: Title of a gist's first revision in the history list.

historyRevision.description: Title of a later gist revision. {{n}} is 1, 2, 3…

historyMeta.description: Revision details: the short commit SHA, then the date and time.

historyChanges.description: Lines added and removed in a revision. Keep the + and − signs.

historyActive.description: Tag on the revision that's currently loaded.

historyEmpty.description: Shown in the history dialog when the gist has no revisions.

historyFailed.description: Shown when the revision list can't be loaded. {{message}} is the error.

loadFailed.description: Error when loading a gist or a revision fails. {{message}} is the error.

openTitle.description: Title of the dialog that loads a gist by URL or ID.

openLabel.description: Label of the field in the open-gist dialog.

openPlaceholder.description: Placeholder in the open-gist field, an example gist URL.

openCurrent.description: Help text in the open-gist dialog showing the URL of the gist that's loaded.

openInvalid.message: Enter a gist URL or a 32-character gist ID.
openInvalid.description: Validation message when the input doesn't contain a gist ID.

noticeDecryptFailed.description: Warning toast title when the stored GitHub token couldn't be decrypted at startup.

noticeDecryptFailedDetail.message: Your saved token couldn't be unlocked, so sign in again to publish gists.
noticeDecryptFailedDetail.description: Warning toast body when the stored GitHub token couldn't be decrypted.

accountLabel.description: Label of the GitHub account row in Settings.

accountSignedInAs.description: Settings text showing the GitHub user name.

accountSignedOut.description: Settings text when no GitHub account is signed in.

accountSignOut.description: Settings button that signs out of GitHub and deletes the stored token.

accountSignIn.description: Settings button that opens the GitHub sign-in dialog.

asRevisionLabel.description: Settings switch for publishing gists in two steps so the gist history shows a diff.

asRevisionHelp.message: Creates the gist from the default template first, then updates it with your files, so the gist's history shows your changes.
asRevisionHelp.description: Help text under the Publish as revision switch.
